integrity: Explicit algebraic proof, two independently implemented computational cross-checks; no independent external audit or validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth ordered coefficient pairs in the explicit two-parameter characteristic-eleven family are classified.
The full elliptic Hasse curve is not asserted irreducible, nor are ordered pairs identified up to curve isomorphism.
The published quotient isogenies and superspecial genus-two criterion are prior work, not original components of this claim.
A Möbius-equivalent family appeared in a 2026 paper; an unindexed equivalent finite rank-two stratum calculation remains a priority risk.
title: Sixteen transverse rank-two parameters of genus-five generalized Howe curves in characteristic eleven
